# Arcan Painting

> Arcan Painting provides interior, exterior, commercial painting, wallpaper services, and specialty finishes for residential and commercial projects in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area.

## Services
- Interior painting (residential and commercial)
- Exterior painting (weather-resistant for Ontario's climate)
- Commercial painting (offices, retail, facilities)
- Wallpaper installation and removal
- Specialty finishes (faux textures, Venetian plaster, limewash)
- Colour consultation

## Service Area
Contact Arcan Painting to discuss availability for your project location.
